veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 4 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Cut the haloumi and capsicums into chunks and halve the mushrooms.
Mix the honey, mustard, garlic and olive oil and toss through the haloumi, mushrooms and capsicum.
Marinate in the fridge.
Thread onto long skewers.
Grill, turning, until charred and the haloumi is golden.

veg.make_ahead: Batter up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Whisk the flour, eggs and milk into a smooth batter.
Rest the batter.
Fry the mushrooms in a little of the butter until golden, then stir in the spinach until wilted.
Cook thin crepes in a buttered pan.
Fill half with the mushrooms, spinach and cheese, fold and warm until melted.
Sprinkle the rest with sugar and lemon juice and fold into quarters.

veg.make_ahead: Make the day before, press overnight

steps.text: Chop the olives and giardiniera together for an olive salad.
Hollow the loaf slightly.
Layer with olive salad, eggplant, capsicum and provolone, then more olive salad.
Wrap tightly and press under a heavy weight overnight in the fridge.
Cut into small wedges.

veg.n: Mushroom, lentil and sage sausage rolls
veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat to serve

steps.text: Cook the onion and mushrooms in the oil until soft and dry.
Mash the lentils and mix with the mushroom mix, sage, breadcrumbs, salt and one beaten egg. Cool.
Halve the pastry sheets and lay the filling along each piece, then roll up and seal.
Brush with the second egg, beaten, and cut into pieces.
Bake at 200C until golden and puffed.
Serve hot with English mustard.
Cut the haloumi into thick fingers and pat dry.
Mix the coconut with the panko.
Dip the haloumi in beaten egg, then press into the coconut mix.
Fry at 180C in batches until golden.
Stir lime juice into the sweet chilli sauce and serve for dipping.
Press the tofu dry and cut into cubes. Toss with the garlic, chilli, lime zest and oil.
Mix the soy sauce, lime juice, water and sugar for the dipping sauce.
Thread the tofu onto skewers.
Grill in batches, turning, until golden at the edges.
Serve from the boat with the dipping sauce.
Soak the vermicelli in boiling water until soft, then drain.
Fry the tofu strips in the oil until golden, then splash with the soy sauce.
Pick the herbs and tear the lettuce.
Warm the peanut butter with the hoisin and a splash of water for a thick dipping sauce.
Soak the rice paper sheets one at a time, fill with tofu, vermicelli, herbs and lettuce and roll tightly.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 week in an airtight tin

steps.text: Melt the dark and white chocolate separately.
Spread the dark chocolate over a lined tray and drizzle with the white, then swirl with a skewer.
Scatter over the lollies, honeycomb, marshmallows and sprinkles, pressing them in lightly.
Chill until set.
Smash into shards.
Split and toast the muffins.
Roughly mash the chickpeas with a fork.
Mix in the mayonnaise, celery, pickles, a squeeze of lemon and pepper.
Spread over the muffin halves and top with cheddar.
Grill until the cheese is bubbling and golden.
Cut each half into quarters and serve warm.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 3 hours, keep covered and chilled

steps.text: Boil the eggs until hard, then cool.
Mash the eggs with salt and mayonnaise.
Spread bread with cream cheese and layer with cucumber.
Fill more with the egg and mustard cress, and the rest with cheddar and a little mustard.
Cut off the crusts, slice into fingers and stack on a tiered plate.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat to serve

steps.text: Dice the mushrooms, potato, swede and onion.
Mix with the cheddar, soy sauce, salt and plenty of pepper.
Cut rounds about 20cm wide from the pastry.
Pile the filling onto one half of each, dot with butter, fold over and crimp the edge.
Brush with beaten egg and cut a small slit.
Bake at 200C for 15 minutes, then drop to 170C and bake until golden and the potato is tender.
Serve with brown sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Lentils up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Simmer the lentils until just tender, drain and dress with the soy sauce and oil. Cool.
Melt the white chocolate gently.
Dip the strawberries halfway in the chocolate and set on baking paper.
Leave the chocolate to set.
Top the blinis with creme fraiche and a little spoonful of the black lentils.
Lay both out on black trays in strict rows, black and white only.
Soak the vermicelli until soft, drain and chop.
Shred the wombok, grate the carrots and chop the mushrooms.
Cook the mushrooms in the tablespoon of oil until browned, then stir in the soy sauce.
Mix the mushrooms with the vermicelli and vegetables and cool.
Roll tightly in the spring roll pastry.
Fry at 180C in batches until crisp and blistered.
Serve hot with sweet chilli sauce.
Cut the cauliflower into bite-size florets.
Mix the flour, panko, paprika and salt. Dip the cauliflower in egg, then in the crumb mix.
Shallow fry in batches until golden and just tender.
Drain and serve with honey mustard.
Mix the plant-based mince with the onion and allspice, then roll into small balls.
Brown the balls in the oil.
Add the cream, a splash of water and the soy sauce and simmer.
Serve on toothpicks with lingonberry jam.
Whisk the cornmeal, flour, baking powder and buttermilk to a thick batter.
Pat the franks dry and push a skewer into each.
Dip in the batter and fry at 180C in batches until golden.
Serve with mustard and tomato sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Make the day before

steps.text: Whisk the agar into the apple juice in a saucepan, bring to the boil and simmer for 2 minutes, stirring.
Stir in the food colouring and pour into glasses.
Chill until set.
Whip the cream.
Top with cream and tuck a slice of orange on each for a little orange fish.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat to serve

steps.text: Boil 6 of the eggs until just set.
Cool and peel the eggs.
Mash the vegetarian sausage filling with the sage, pepper and a handful of the breadcrumbs.
Wrap the mixture around each egg.
Roll in flour, the last egg, beaten, and the rest of the breadcrumbs.
Fry at 170C in two batches.
Halve and serve with mustard.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Season the beetroot slices with a squeeze of lemon and a pinch of sea salt.
Spread the oatcakes with cream cheese.
Top with folds of beetroot and a sprig of dill.
Squeeze over a little more lemon and lay out on a slate.
Cut the cauliflower into large florets.
Whisk the flour, milk and salt into a batter and coat the florets.
Spread on an oiled tray, drizzle with the rest of the oil and bake at 220C until crisp.
Warm the barbecue sauce with the honey.
Toss the florets through the sauce and bake again until sticky.
Mix the sour cream with the mayonnaise and chives for a ranch dip and serve alongside.

veg.make_ahead: Batter up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Whisk the flour, eggs and milk into a smooth batter.
Rest the batter.
Fry the mushrooms in a little of the butter until golden, then stir in the spinach until wilted.
Cook thin crepes in a buttered pan.
Fill each with the mushrooms, spinach and cheese and fold into quarters.
Crisp again in the pan.
Cut into triangles and serve hot.

veg.n: Barber shop bagel bites with carrot lox
veg.make_ahead: Carrots up to 2 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Peel the carrots into long ribbons with a vegetable peeler.
Blanch the ribbons in boiling water for 1 minute and drain well.
Toss with the oil, soy sauce, smoked paprika and lemon juice and leave to marinate.
Split and toast the bagels.
Spread with cream cheese.
Top each with a fold of carrot, a few capers and thin slices of red onion.
Lay them out on a tray.
Fry the mushrooms in 1 tablespoon of the oil until browned and dry, then cool.
Mix with the tofu, wombok, ginger, spring onion, soy sauce and salt.
Fill the wrappers and pleat.
Fry in the rest of the oil until crisp underneath.
Add a splash of water, cover and steam.
Serve with black vinegar.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Blend 2 mangoes into a puree.
Whisk the agar and sugar into the water in a saucepan, bring to the boil and simmer for 2 minutes, stirring.
Stir in the puree and warm through.
Stir in the evaporated milk.
Pour into glasses.
Chill until set.
Dice the remaining mango and use to top the puddings.
Shape the plant-based mince into small patties and season with the salt.
Cook in the oil on a hot pan, turning once, adding half a slice of cheese at the end.
Put into the buns with pickles and tomato sauce.
Cut the shortcrust into small rounds and press into a patty tin.
Fill with fruit mince.
Bake at 190C until golden.
Cool the tarts.
Season the beetroot slices with a squeeze of lemon.
Top the blinis with creme fraiche, a fold of beetroot and a sprig of dill.
Arrange both on trays.
Season the beetroot with a squeeze of lemon, then top the blinis with creme fraiche, beetroot and dill.
Boil the water with the butter for the gougeres.
Beat in the flour until the dough pulls away from the pan.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the cheese.
Pipe small balls onto lined trays.
Bake at 200C until puffed and golden.
Arrange both on silver trays.

veg.n: Shell Cottage seaside palm heart toasts

ingredients.item: cans hearts of palm (400g each), drained

steps.text: Shred the hearts of palm into flakes with a fork.
Fold through the mayonnaise with lemon zest, a squeeze of juice, the chives and the nori.
Toast the sourdough and cut into fingers.
Pile the mix on top.
Finish with smoked paprika.
Cut the cauliflower into large florets.
Whisk the flour, water and salt into a batter and coat the florets.
Spread on an oiled tray, drizzle with the rest of the oil and bake at 220C until crisp.
Warm the honey with the soy sauce and chilli until sticky.
Toss the florets through the sauce and bake again until glazed.
Scatter with sesame seeds.

veg.n: Cheddar, vegetable pie and pickle board

steps.text: Cut the cheddar into wedges and slice the pies.
Cut the apples into wedges and tear the bread.
Pile everything onto a big board with the pickled onions so guests can raid it at once.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Slice a few pickled onions into thin rings and pick the dill into small sprigs.
Spread each rye crispbread with creme fraiche.
Crumble the smoked tofu over the top, squeeze over a little lemon and finish with a dill sprig and a few onion rings.
Arrange on a wooden board and serve cold.

veg.n: Dáin's Iron Hills mushroom and lentil pies
veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled (bake fresh)

steps.text: Dice the onion and cut the pastry into rounds to fit a 12-hole muffin tin.
Brown the mushrooms and onion in oil, add the lentils, stock and soy sauce and simmer until thick.
Cool the filling for 15 minutes while you line the tin with shortcrust rounds.
Fill each case, top with a puff pastry lid and cut a small steam hole.
Bake at 200C until golden, then serve with tomato sauce.
Toast the bread and butter it while hot.
Mash the beans with the olive oil, a squeeze of lemon, salt and pepper and spread on half the toast.
Drizzle honey over the rest.
Cut into fingers and serve with a pot of tea.
Whisk the agar and sugar into the juice in a saucepan, bring to the boil and simmer for 2 minutes, stirring.
Divide the raspberries between four glasses and pour the jelly over.
Chill until set.
Whip the cream, dust the jellies with glitter and top with cream.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat in the oven

steps.text: Cube the mozzarella, cut the capsicum into small pieces and heat the oven to 200C.
Cut the dough into small pieces and wrap each around a cube of cheese, a piece of capsicum and a pinch of smoked paprika.
Roll into balls and pack into a greased tin.
Bake until golden.
Melt the butter with crushed garlic and brush over the balls. Warm the sauce for dipping.
Fry the mushrooms and cabbage in the oil until soft and dry, then cool.
Mix with the soy sauce, sliced spring onion and ginger.
Fill the wrappers and pleat closed.
Steam the momos.
Char the tomatoes in a dry pan, then blitz with chilli flakes, salt and garlic for the achar.
Warm the sauerkraut with the caraway seeds.
Grill the franks until they blister.
Tuck into the buns with mustard and sauerkraut and wrap in wax paper.
Boil the eggs until hard.
Cool, peel and halve the eggs.
Cut the cheddar into wedges and slice the bread thickly.
Lay the cheese, eggs, onions and chutney on a board with the bread and butter.
Cut the cauliflower into large florets.
Whisk the flour, water, paprika and salt into a batter and coat the florets.
Spread on an oiled tray, drizzle with the rest of the oil and bake at 220C until crisp.
Warm the barbecue sauce, honey and butter until glossy.
Toss the florets through the glaze and bake again until sticky. Serve with napkins.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Halve the figs and season the beetroot slices with a squeeze of lemon.
Top each blini with creme fraiche and a fold of beetroot.
Top each fig half with goat's cheese and a drizzle of honey.
Arrange both on silver trays.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Slice a few pickled onions into rings and pick the dill into sprigs.
Spread the crispbreads with creme fraiche.
Crumble the smoked tofu over the top and finish with onion rings and dill.
Serve cold on a slate.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, eggs and buttermilk to a thick batter.
Cook small pancakes in butter until golden.
Toast the pecans in a dry pan, then toss with a tablespoon of maple syrup, the smoked paprika and salt until sticky.
Stack the pancakes with the smoky pecans between and pour over the rest of the maple syrup.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Slice a few pickled onions into rings and season the beetroot with a pinch of sea salt.
Spread the crispbreads with creme fraiche.
Top with a fold of beetroot, a sprig of dill and onion rings.
Serve cold on a slate.
Dice the onion and chop the olives.
Brown the plant-based mince with the onion, cumin and a splash of the oil, stir in the olives and cool.
Cut pastry into rounds, fill, fold and crimp.
Bake at 200C until golden.
Blitz parsley, garlic, vinegar and the rest of the oil for chimichurri.
Fry the mushrooms in half the butter with the smoked paprika until tender, then splash with soy sauce.
Fry the eggs until just set.
Split and toast the muffins and butter them.
Fill each with mushroom, egg and cheese and wrap tightly in paper so the cheese melts.

veg.make_ahead: Dry the tofu overnight

steps.text: Press the tofu, cut into bites and rub with the salt.
Dry uncovered on a rack in the fridge overnight.
Toss with the cornflour and oil.
Roast at 240C, turning once, until puffed and crackling at the edges.
Serve with lime wedges and hot sauce.
Dice the onion and potatoes.
Fry the mushrooms in the butter with the smoked paprika until golden, then soften the onion and potato.
Add the stock, nori and milk and simmer until the potato is tender.
Stir in the cream, season well and ladle into small cups with the crackers.
Cut the potatoes into thick chips and dry well.
Fry the chips once at a lower heat until soft.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the stock and soy sauce and simmer until thick.
Fry the chips again at high heat until crisp.
Pile into bowls, scatter with torn mozzarella and pour over the hot gravy.
Slice the eggplant lengthwise into 8 thin slices and halve each. Brush with the oil, soy sauce, paprika and maple syrup.
Cook the strips in a hot pan for about a minute each side until just soft. Pit the dates.
Wrap a strip around each date and secure with a toothpick.
Bake at 200C on a lined tray, turning once, until the edges are crisp.
Rinse and cook the rice, then let it cool until warm.
Crumble the tofu and fry in the sesame oil until golden, then add the soy sauce and a pinch of salt.
Shape the rice into triangles around a little tofu.
Wrap the base in nori and sprinkle with sesame.
Pack into a bento box with pickled ginger.
Soak 12 bamboo skewers in water. Press the tofu dry, cut into cubes and thread onto skewers with the mushrooms.
Simmer the soy, mirin and sugar until syrupy.
Grill the skewers, basting with the glaze, until sticky and charred.
Scatter with sliced spring onion.
Soak 12 bamboo skewers in water. Press the tofu dry, cut into cubes and thread onto skewers with the mushrooms.
Simmer the soy, honey, rice vinegar, water and sugar until syrupy.
Grill the skewers, basting with the glaze, until sticky and charred.
Scatter with sliced spring onion.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 week, airtight

steps.text: Line a 20cm square tin with baking paper.
Melt both chocolates together in short bursts in the microwave.
Stir in the marshmallows, broken honeycomb, peanuts and lollies.
Spread into the tin and chill until firm.
Smash or cut into chunks and pile in a bowl.
Press the tofu dry, cut into chunks and season with salt. Beat the eggs.
Dip in egg and press into panko.
Spread on a lined tray, spray with oil and bake at 220C until golden.
Mix the honey and mustard for dipping.

veg.n: Metro City black bean quesadilla wedges

steps.text: Dice the capsicum and slice the spring onions.
Lightly crush the beans and mix with the cheese, capsicum, spring onions and paprika.
Spread over half of each tortilla and fold over.
Cook in a dry pan over medium heat, a few minutes a side, until golden and melted.
Cut each into four wedges and serve with salsa and sour cream.
Whisk the agar and sugar into the grape juice in a saucepan, bring to the boil and simmer for 2 minutes, stirring.
Pour into clear cups.
Chill until set.
Whip the cream and swirl on top.
Add two banana slices to each like goggles.
Fry the mushrooms in a third of the butter until golden.
Make a bechamel from the rest of the butter, the flour and milk.
Spread the bread with Dijon, fill with mushrooms and grated cheese and arrange on a tray.
Top with bechamel and more grated cheese.
Grill until bubbling.
Cut into small squares and serve on a silver tray.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat to serve

steps.text: Boil the four eggs until just set.
Cool and peel.
Mash the vegetarian sausage filling with a handful of the panko.
Wrap each egg in the mixture.
Roll in flour, beaten egg and the rest of the panko.
Fry at 170C until golden.
Halve and serve with mustard.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 3 days, reheats well

steps.text: Soak the beans in plenty of cold water overnight.
Simmer the beans in fresh water until tender.
Fry the chopped onion in the oil with the smoked paprika, then stir in the beans, molasses, mustard, soy sauce and water to cover.
Simmer until thick and smoky.
Serve in tin cups.
Cube the cheddar and quarter the artichokes.
Pack small tins with crackers, cheese, artichokes and pickled onions.
Close the lids and hand them out.

veg.n: Spinach and cheese puff pastry triangles

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Wilt the spinach in a dry pan, cool and squeeze out the water.
Cut the pastry into squares and grate the cheese.
Fill each with spinach and cheddar, fold into triangles and press the edges with a fork.
Brush with beaten egg.
Bake until golden.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Pick the dill into sprigs.
Spread the crispbreads with cream cheese.
Top with folds of beetroot and a sprig of dill.
Squeeze over a little lemon and lay on a wooden board.
Heat the oven to 220C. Roll the dough thin and cut into small rounds.
Top each with sauce, grated mozzarella, a few slices of mushroom and oregano.
Bake until crisp and bubbling.
Cut the mango and kiwifruit into little fish shapes.
Whisk the agar into the apple juice in a saucepan, bring to the boil and simmer for 2 minutes, stirring. Stir in the colouring.
Cool for a few minutes, then pour into clear glasses and drop in the fruit.
Chill until set.
Whip the cream and spoon on top like sea foam.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, keep chilled

ingredients.item: cans hearts of palm (400g each), drained

steps.text: Cut the hearts of palm into thick pieces and toss with the juice of one lemon and the salt.
Chill in the fridge until very cold.
Mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce and hot sauce.
Pile the hearts of palm on crushed ice with the second lemon cut into wedges and the sauce alongside.
Tear the mushrooms into large clumps. Whisk the flour, cornflour and soda water to a thin, lumpy batter.
Heat the oil to 180C.
Dip the mushrooms in the batter and fry until puffed and crisp.
Stir lime juice into the sweet chilli sauce for dipping.
Cut the mushrooms into thick coins and score the tops. Crush the garlic, chop the chilli, zest and juice a lime and cut the rest into wedges. Melt the butter.
Toss the mushrooms with garlic, chilli, zest and butter.
Grill a few minutes a side until charred and tender.
Pile onto a platter with lime wedges, the lime juice and the pan butter.
Heat the oven to 250C. Stretch the dough thin on a big tray.
Spread with sauce, grated mozzarella, capsicum, mushrooms and oregano.
Bake until bubbling.
Cut into squares.
Heat the oven to 200C. Cut the pastry into 24 strips.
Wrap a strip around each vegetarian sausage, seam underneath, and lay on a lined tray.
Brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Bake until puffed and golden.
Line up on a board with tomato sauce and mustard.
Break the chocolate into squares.
Toast the marshmallows over a flame or under a hot grill until golden.
Sandwich each between two biscuits with chocolate, squashing so it melts.
Fry the mushrooms and cabbage in the oil until soft and dry, then cool.
Mix with the soy sauce, sliced spring onion and ginger.
Fill the wrappers and pleat closed.
Steam.
Char the tomatoes in a dry pan and blitz with chilli flakes and salt for dipping.
Soak 8 skewers. Crush the garlic, chop the chilli, zest a lime and cut the rest into wedges. Melt the butter.
Cut the haloumi into cubes, toss with garlic, chilli, zest and butter and thread onto skewers.
Grill a couple of minutes a side until charred.
Serve with lime wedges and spoon over any butter left in the pan.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Dice the mangoes.
Whisk the agar and sugar into the coconut milk in a saucepan.
Bring to the boil and simmer for 2 minutes, stirring.
Pour into glasses and chill until set.
Top with mango and passionfruit pulp.
Cut the potatoes into wedges and toss with 2 tablespoons of oil and the sweet paprika.
Pat the chickpeas dry and toss with the rest of the oil and the smoked paprika.
Roast the wedges at 220C, adding the chickpeas on a second tray for the last 25 minutes.
Grate the cheddar and slice the spring onions.
Top the wedges with cheddar and the crisp chickpeas and bake until melted.
Add sour cream and spring onion.
